fields.why: No design is named; the report states equity as a program goal and judges coverage against it ('equity was found in two states', 'equity ... has not been achieved'), which fits monitoring against a stated goal. With no numeric target, surveillance/descriptive is also defensible.

The Age ≥65 yrs SVI indicator gives three ordered county tertiles compared with the high-vulnerability referent, exactly parallel to the racial/ethnic minority indicator both readers recorded; B left it out. By the same logic, the disability and limited-English indicators (both stratifiers in both records) would also be entries, which neither reader gave.

brief_issues: The brief does not say whether each single-indicator tertile of an area index (SVI) is a groupwise entry on that indicator's own SPD (age, disability, nativity) or folds into SES as an area index. Readers applied it to some indicators and not others.
